notes.title: Demo 1.26.80 Update | Experience Optimisation
notes.notes:
Quick save available: F5 quick save, F9 quick load.
 Increase the order of actions.
 Clicking on an enemy target in battle can display the target's movement range.
 You can set the screen saturation, contrast, and image zoom.
 The map can be dragged around, and the focus returns to the character after double-clicking the mouse.


If you have any suggestions or comments, please let me know at DISCORD.

notes.title: Demo 1.24.79 Update | Translation Optimisation
